instances.//: The training range. Runs bfrange.dll, not bflib.dll. Never counted toward campaign totals, left out of the campaign dashboard's selector (GET /api/instances), served under /api/range/.
instances.label: Vector Strike Training Range
instances.//kind: "range" for a bfrange server. Defaults to "campaign".
instances.//base: netidx_base from the range's _RANGE config. The live map, spawning and the weapon database come over RPCs under <base>/<sortie>/api/.
instances.//stats_jsonl: Identity stats (connect, slot, takeoff, land), ingested like a campaign's.
instances.//range_jsonl: The graded results, one RangeRecord per line. Optional: defaults to range.jsonl next to stats_jsonl.
instances.//tacview_dir: Where Tacview writes this server's .acmi files (= tacviewExportPath). Optional: unset turns off the range site's Tacview downloads.
